The CI failure was caused by architectural rule **ARCH-4** (*"Published events never break a deployed consumer: changes are additive; renames and removals go through deprecation"*). Deployed consumers (`analytics-ingest` requiring `placedAt` and `billing-service` requiring `totalCents`) broke when those fields were removed rather than deprecated.

### Solution
1. **Preserve backward compatibility during deprecation**:
   - In [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L36), added `createdAt` and `amountCents` as requested, while retaining `@deprecated` `placedAt` and `totalCents` fields.
   - In [`orderPlaced()`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/src/core/events.ts#L52-L72), populated both sets of fields: `createdAt`/`placedAt` and `amountCents`/`totalCents`.
2. **Update tests**:
   - In [test/app.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/test/app.test.ts) and [test/adapters.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/test/adapters.test.ts), verified both new and deprecated fields are present on the event payload.

### Verification
- **Consumer contract checks (ARCH-4 / ARCH-8)**:
  ```
  ARCH-4 PASS analytics-ingest: OrderCancelled (2 required fields present)
  ARCH-4 PASS analytics-ingest: OrderPlaced (6 required fields present)
  ARCH-4 PASS billing-service: OrderPlaced (5 required fields present)
  ARCH-8 PASS web-storefront: GET /orders/{id} (9 required fields present)
  ```
- **`npm test`**: All 39 unit and integration tests passing.
- **`npm run typecheck` & `npm run arch`**: Passed without any violations.
